alternatives.name: Use TypeVar bound to the class
alternatives.description: Define T = TypeVar('T', bound='MyClass') and use it as the return type for methods that return self.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Requires boilerplate TypeVar declaration for every class. Self is a common enough pattern to warrant dedicated syntax.

alternatives.name: Implicit Self inference
alternatives.description: Let type checkers automatically infer Self return types for methods that return self.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Not all methods returning self should be typed as Self (some might return a fixed base class). Explicit is better than implicit.
